what.zh: 用一句话出图，或拿已有的图做修改、抽取、换风格。Tripo 把多家图像模型接在同一个接口后面。
what.en: Make an image from a sentence, or edit, extract or restyle an existing one. Tripo puts several image models behind one API.

when.zh: 建模之前先出概念图锁定风格；再从概念图里抽出单个物体的参考图交给图生 3D。
when.en: Before modelling: lock the look with a concept, then extract one clean reference per object for image-to-3D.

note.zh: 默认，均衡
note.en: Default, balanced

note.zh: 质量更高，图生图编辑最强
note.en: Higher quality; strongest for editing

note.zh: 快速 / 高质量 / 最新快速
note.en: Fast / higher quality / latest fast

note.zh: GPT 系最新
note.en: Latest GPT-family

note.zh: 速度档，本站实测使用
note.en: Speed tier — used on this site

note.zh: 保真档，编辑时最能保留原图
note.en: Fidelity tier — best at preserving the rest of an image

note.zh: 必填（图生图有模板时可省）；中英文均可，负面词写在 --no 后
note.en: Required (optional with a template on image-to-image); zh/en; negatives after --no

note.zh: 各模型支持的尺寸不同，默认 2048x2048
note.en: Supported sizes vary by model; default 2048x2048

note.zh: 仅 chat_image 系列；省略即 low，high 以上更贵更慢
note.en: chat_image only; omitted = low; high+ costs more and is slower

note.zh: 仅 2.5 系列：auto / opaque / transparent
note.en: 2.5 tiers only: auto / opaque / transparent

note.zh: 图生图的参考图：公网 URL、file_token，或上一个图片任务的 task_id
note.en: Image-to-image references: public URL, file_token, or a previous image task_id

note.zh: 如 t_pose、variants、figure、3d_enhance（让图更适合转 3D）
note.en: e.g. t_pose, variants, figure, 3d_enhance (prepares an image for 3D)

note.zh: OpenAI 兼容接口，可以直接用 OpenAI SDK 调 gpt-image-2 / 2.5
note.en: OpenAI-compatible endpoints: call gpt-image-2 / 2.5 with the OpenAI SDK

credits.zh: 按模型和尺寸档计费（≤1K / 2K / 4K）：seedream 一律 5；chat_image_2 与 2.5 系列 10/10/15，high 及以上更贵。本站实测：1536×1024、medium，约 25 秒，10 credits。图像生成每个账户同时只能跑 1 个任务。
credits.en: Priced per model and size tier (≤1K / 2K / 4K): seedream 5 flat; chat_image_2 and 2.5 tiers 10/10/15, more for high and above. Measured here: 1536×1024, medium, ~25 s, 10 credits. Image generation runs one task per account at a time.

what.zh: 把一张图（或一句话）变成带贴图的 3D 模型。核心是选对模型系列：H 系列追求细节，P 系列追求干净的低面数。
what.en: Turns an image (or a sentence) into a textured 3D model. The key choice is the model family: H for detail, P for clean low-poly.

when.zh: 主体道具、角色、生物、造型复杂的物体。规则几何（桌子、底座、重复构件）用代码生成更划算。
when.en: Hero props, characters, creatures, complex shapes. Regular geometry (tables, bases, repeated parts) is cheaper to generate in code.

note.zh: H 系列最新，高精度，默认推荐；主体资产、3D 打印
note.en: Latest H-series, high precision, default; hero assets, 3D printing

note.zh: H 系列旧版，兼容老项目
note.en: Older H-series for compatibility

note.zh: P 系列低面数，face_limit 50–20,000，拓扑干净；游戏、移动端
note.en: P-series low-poly, face_limit 50–20,000, clean topology; games, mobile

note.zh: P 系列预览版，支持四边面，面数到 50,000
note.en: P-series preview, supports quads, up to 50,000 faces

note.zh: file_token、公网 URL，或 Tripo 图片任务的 task_id
note.en: file_token, public URL, or a Tripo image task_id

note.zh: 默认都开；只要白模必须两个都设 false
note.en: Both on by default; set both false for bare geometry

note.zh: H 系列不传就自适应（最高 150 万面）；P1 为 50–20,000
note.en: H-series adapts if omitted (up to 1.5M); P1 50–20,000

note.zh: H 系列一键低模，面数 500–20,000，+10 credits
note.en: H-series one-click low-poly, 500–20,000 faces, +10 credits

note.zh: detailed 即 Ultra 几何，+20 credits
note.en: detailed = Ultra geometry, +20 credits

note.zh: fast / standard / detailed / extreme（8K）
note.en: fast / standard / detailed / extreme (8K)

note.zh: 四边面，强制输出 FBX，+5 credits
note.en: Quads; forces FBX output, +5 credits

note.zh: 按真实米制尺寸输出、导出 UV
note.en: Real-world metre scale, export UVs

credits.zh: 图生 3D：H 系列 20（白模）/ 30（带贴图）；P1 40/50；P2 100/110。本站实测 v3.1 带 PBR：30 credits，与定价一致。1 credit = 0.01 美元。
credits.en: Image-to-3D: H-series 20 (bare) / 30 (textured); P1 40/50; P2 100/110. Measured here, v3.1 with PBR: 30 credits, matching the price list. 1 credit = $0.01.

what.zh: 从一张图生成由无数半透明小点组成的 .splat，看起来很写实，但它不是网格，不能直接编辑或进游戏引擎。
what.en: Turns one image into a .splat made of countless soft translucent points: photoreal-looking, but not a mesh, so it can’t be edited or used as game geometry directly.

when.zh: 网页或展示里要“看起来像照片”的实时预览。
when.en: Photo-like real-time previews on the web or in showcases.

note.zh: 一张图；可固定随机种子
note.en: One image; optional fixed seed

what.zh: 同一个模型可以只要白模、要基础颜色，或要完整的 PBR 材质（粗糙度、金属度、法线），光照下才显得真实。
what.en: The same model can come bare, with base colour, or with full PBR (roughness, metalness, normals) so it reacts to light realistically.

when.zh: 要在网页或引擎里直接展示：开 PBR。打算自己在 Blender 里重做材质：关掉贴图省时间。已有模型想换皮：用重新贴图接口。
when.en: Showing it directly in a browser or engine: PBR on. Re-materialising in Blender: textures off. Re-skinning an existing model: use the re-texture endpoint.

note.zh: fast / standard / detailed / extreme（8K）
note.en: fast / standard / detailed / extreme (8K)

note.zh: 重新贴图：text、image、images 三选一；四视图顺序为 front, left, back, right
note.en: Re-texture: one of text, image, images; four views ordered front, left, back, right

note.zh: 去掉烘焙进贴图的光影、把材质烘焙成贴图
note.en: Remove baked lighting; bake materials into textures

credits.zh: 建模时开贴图已含在价格里。单独重新贴图：Fast 10 / Standard 10 / HD 20 / 8K 30。
credits.en: Texturing during generation is included. Re-texturing alone: Fast 10 / Standard 10 / HD 20 / 8K 30.

what.zh: 先用一张图生成前、左、后、右四个视图（也可以用自己拍的），再用多视图建模，比只看一张图更准确。
what.en: Generate front/left/back/right views from one image (or use your own photos), then build from multiple views for a more faithful model.

when.zh: 有产品实拍或设计三视图时。
when.en: When you have product photos or design orthographic views.

note.zh: 四张图按 [front, left, back, right] 排列，必须有 front，至少 2 张
note.en: Ordered [front, left, back, right]; front required, at least 2 images

note.zh: 可以逐个视图修改，每张 5 credits
note.en: Edit individual views, 5 credits each

credits.zh: 生成四视图 10；多视图建模 H 系列 20/30，P1 40/50。
credits.en: Generate four views: 10; multiview-to-3D H-series 20/30, P1 40/50.

what.zh: 把一个整体模型拆成独立部件；拆开后被挡住的部分可以用补全接口补齐。也可以在建模时直接要求分件输出。
what.en: Split one model into parts; hidden surfaces revealed by the split can be filled with the completion endpoint. Or ask for parts during generation.

when.zh: 需要单独换色、替换零件或给某个部件做动画时。
when.en: When you need to recolour, swap or animate individual pieces.

note.zh: 默认，按几何拆分
note.en: Default, geometry-based

note.zh: Beta，带语义标签（例如“车轮”）
note.en: Beta, with semantic labels (e.g. ‘wheel’)

note.zh: 建模时直接分件，要求 texture 和 pbr 都为 false，+20 credits
note.en: Parts at generation time; needs texture and pbr false, +20 credits

note.zh: v2 专用，控制拆多细
note.en: v2 only: how fine to split

note.zh: 一步完成：从图片或模型直接得到分件结果
note.en: One step from an image or model to parts

credits.zh: 分割 40；部件补全 50（快速封口 30）；智能分割 图片 85 / 模型 55。
credits.en: Segment 40; part completion 50 (quick cap 30); smart segmentation image 85 / model 55.

what.zh: 把太密的模型减到目标面数、整理成干净的三角面或四边面；Smart UV 重新展开贴图坐标，原贴图和骨骼会一起映射过去。
what.en: Reduce a dense model to a target face count with clean triangles or quads; Smart UV re-unwraps texture coordinates and carries textures and rigs across.

when.zh: 要进游戏引擎、手机或网页，面数和 UV 必须可控的时候。
when.en: When a model must hit a face and UV budget for engines, phones or the web.

note.en: Optional smart_uv; tris 500–20,000, quads 500–10,000

note.zh: v2.0 默认；v1.0 面数上限更高
note.en: v2.0 default; v1.0 allows higher limits

note.zh: 目标面数、是否四边面
note.en: Target faces, quads or not

credits.zh: 重拓扑 v3.0 三角 35 / 四边 40，v2.0 30，v1.0 10；Smart UV 20。
credits.en: Retopology v3.0 tris 35 / quads 40, v2.0 30, v1.0 10; Smart UV 20.

what.zh: 先免费检查模型能不能绑骨，再自动绑骨，最后给它套上走、跑、跳等预设动作。
what.en: Check for free whether a model can be rigged, auto-rig it, then apply preset motions like walk, run or jump.

when.zh: 角色要在游戏或视频里动起来时。
when.en: When a character needs to move in a game or video.

note.zh: 人形（biped），90+ 预设动作
note.en: Humanoid (biped), 90+ preset motions

note.zh: 非人形：四足、鸟类、蛇形、水生等
note.en: Non-humanoid: quadruped, avian, serpentine, aquatic…

note.zh: biped / quadruped / hexapod / octopod / avian / serpentine / aquatic
note.en: biped / quadruped / hexapod / octopod / avian / serpentine / aquatic

note.zh: tripo 或 mixamo 骨骼规范
note.en: tripo or mixamo skeleton spec

note.zh: 如 preset:walk；retarget 只接受 rig 任务的 task_id
note.en: e.g. preset:walk; retarget takes a rig task_id

credits.zh: 能否绑骨检查免费；自动绑骨 25；每个动作 10。
credits.en: Rig check free; auto-rig 25; 10 per animation.

what.zh: 把模型转成乐高、体素等风格。V3 文档目前只在迁移表里列出这个接口，没有参数说明，所以这里只是概念演示。
what.en: Converts a model into styles like brick or voxel. The V3 docs list this endpoint only in the migration table with no parameter page, so this is a concept demo.

when.zh: 同一套资产要适配不同风格的游戏或视觉。
when.en: When one asset set must fit different art directions.

what.zh: 把模型转成不同软件需要的格式，顺便整理：减面、四边面、把轴心放到底部、缩放、贴图尺寸。
what.en: Converts a model for each tool and tidies it: decimate, quads, pivot to bottom-centre, scale, texture size.

when.zh: 网页用 GLB，引擎常用 FBX，苹果 AR 用 USDZ，3D 打印用 STL。
when.en: GLB for web, FBX for engines, USDZ for Apple AR, STL for printing.

note.zh: GLTF / FBX / USDZ / OBJ / STL / 3MF
note.en: GLTF / FBX / USDZ / OBJ / STL / 3MF

note.zh: blender / 3dsmax / mixamo / bake_scale
note.en: blender / 3dsmax / mixamo / bake_scale

note.zh: 轴心放到底部中心、整体缩放
note.en: Pivot to bottom-centre, uniform scale

note.zh: 调整朝向要放在最后一步做，否则后续绑骨或贴图可能方向错误
note.en: Set orientation only at the last step, or later rigging/texturing may face the wrong way

credits.zh: 基础转换 5；用了减面、四边面、改轴心、缩放、贴图尺寸等高级选项为 10。
credits.en: Basic 5; 10 with advanced options such as face limit, quads, pivot, scale or texture size.

what.zh: 所有生成都是异步任务：提交后拿到 task_id，轮询状态，成功后尽快下载。
what.en: Every generation is an async task: submit, get a task_id, poll, download soon after success.

when.zh: 每一次调用都会遇到。理解它就能避免重复扣费。
when.en: Every call. Understanding it prevents double charges.

note.zh: queued → running → success；终态还有 failed / cancelled / banned / expired
note.en: queued → running → success; other terminal states: failed / cancelled / banned / expired

note.zh: 并发上限：同类任务同时只能跑一个（本站制作时真实遇到）
note.en: Concurrency limit: one task of a kind at a time (hit for real while building this site)

note.zh: 频率限制，按 API Key 计算
note.en: Rate limit, per API key

note.zh: 下载链接约 5 分钟失效，过期就重新查询原任务
note.en: Download links expire in ~5 min; re-query the same task

note.zh: 上传 JPEG/PNG，最大 20 MB，返回 file_token
note.en: Upload JPEG/PNG up to 20 MB, returns file_token

credits.zh: 提交时冻结额度，成功才扣除，失败或取消会释放。官方没有幂等键，所以付费请求不能盲目重发。
credits.en: Credits are frozen at submit, charged on success, released on failure. There is no idempotency key, so never blindly resend a paid request.
